wins: Maintained operational awareness throughout the episode, capturing vending machine telemetry that confirmed agent persistence attempts.
Successfully exercised enumeration scripts to map out exposed services despite lack of final success, proving toolchain readiness.
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to missing valid credentials and ineffective fallback exploitation paths.
Unable to achieve mission objective within time limit, likely from repeated recon dead-ends and not chaining findings quickly.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase ran smoothly with thorough tooling, but failure to convert findings into exploit timelines prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to pivot from service discovery to credential harvesting after open port identification.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 is reachable on target and application banner indicates CMS engine
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto with targeted plugin list and use CMS-specific enumeration (wordpress_enum, drupal_enum)

skill_cards.if_condition: When nmap scan reveals SMB service (port 445) along with anonymous login allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient to enumerate shares and invoke enum4linux for user list

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open but brute-force blocked, yet credentials are incomplete in memory
skill_cards.then_action: Run ssh-audit and use ssh2john/John the Ripper on captured keys, then attempt key-based auth

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SMB share enumeration providing actionable footholds during recon.

next_experiments.title: Credential Pivot Experiment
next_experiments.description: After confirming SMB anonymous access, chain the smbclient findings into NTLM relay or pass-the-hash attempts using Responder + wmiexec.py to test lateral movement capability.

next_experiments.title: CMS Exploit Validation
next_experiments.description: Target identified CMS services with more aggressive exploit checks (e.g., CMSmap or Metasploit auxiliary modules) to convert enumeration into RCE artifacts.

next_experiments.title: SSH Key Harvesting Workflow
next_experiments.description: Capture and crack SSH private keys from previous recon steps, then validate key-based authentication before attempting brute-force.
